interface.title: DIMS Dashboard — ORTHO (Multimodal Synchrony Exploration Visualization)
interface.field: Developmental and interaction psychology: multimodal parent–child interaction (joint ball-maze task with eye tracking, gesture and speech coding)
interface.stage_of_work: Exploratory analysis and visualization of data that has already been recorded and processed
interface.what_it_is_for: Picking one recorded parent–child session and one point in time, then seeing the ball's movement, its path on the board, recurrence (RQA) plots, cross-wavelet coherence and coded ELAN behaviour for a window around that point.

data.note: There are 12 pre-built sessions in the Video ID dropdown (CUF00_L0_A01 … CUG22_L0_A03, plus the partial exports CUF00_L1_A1 and CUF00_L1_A2). There are no video files, so both video players stay empty. A transcript appeared only for the L1 sessions: CUF00_L1_A1 shows one, and CUF00_L1_A2 shows only the lines inside the selected window. On CUF00_L0_A01 and CUF00_L0_A02 the replay always saw 'No transcript available', even with SUB-EN speech in the window. In every session I opened (CUF00_L0_A01, CUF00_L1_A1, CUF00_L1_A2, CUG22_L0_A1), the cross-wavelet title says 'Coherence chance level: not computed for this output. Set analysis.crosswavelet.mcCount in config.json and rebuild.' Display settings are not part of the analysis. The Theme dropdown only recolours the page (Midnight is dark; screens/025.webp). The camera Perspective dropdown (e.g. 'parent'; screens/026.webp) changes nothing visible because no recordings are present.

features.name: Linked time-window cursor across multiple views
features.general: Pick one moment by clicking any chart, dragging a slider or clicking an event. A window of chosen width around it is then shaded in every linked chart, and a status line reports the selection.
features.specific: Clicking a data point on a Plotly plot (time series, recurrence plot, RQA metric, cross-wavelet input series, ELAN bar) or dragging the time slider sets 'Selected time: X s (window: N s)'. The shaded band then updates in all tabs, along with the Segment heading. Plot clicks do not move the slider, whose 'Time:' label keeps its old value. Clicking empty plot space or the band-average panel does nothing.
steps: Choose a session
Set Window Size in seconds
Click a data point on a plot or drag the time slider (the slider does not follow plot clicks)
Read 'Selected time' in the status line rather than the slider label
Switch tabs to see the same window shaded in each view
serves_tasks: Choose a time point that all views focus on
Widen or narrow the analysis window
Read the speech spoken in the current window

features.name: Recurrence plot with marginal series and windowed RQA measures (continuous signals)
features.general: Show when a continuous signal returns close to earlier states, using a distance threshold, as a time × time recurrence matrix with the signal drawn along both axes. Under it, sliding-window measures (recurrence rate, determinism, laminarity, mean line length) are plotted with the current window highlighted.
features.specific: RQA Plots tab: one panel each for vx and vy (header shows Recurrence Rate and Threshold), with RR/DET/LAM/seconds curves below. Hovering a cell gives the time pair, hovering a curve gives its value (e.g. 'DET 39.4 s: 0.720'), and clicking moves the window.
steps: Open the RQA Plots tab
Read the recurrence matrix with its Recurrence Rate and Threshold
Hover cells or metric curves for exact values
Click a cell or curve to move the shared window there
serves_tasks: Inspect a recurrence plot and windowed recurrence measures for each movement signal

features.name: Categorical recurrence plot for coded attention
features.general: Show when one person's coded state (e.g. where they look) recurs, as a time × time recurrence matrix for a categorical signal with the codes drawn along the axes. There is one plot per partner.
features.specific: RQA Plots tab, below vx/vy: categorical RQA panels for gaze_parent and gaze_child with a Recurrence Rate header (CUF00_L0_A01: 62.58% and 58.29%). Hovering a cell gives the time pair, and clicking moves the shared window.
steps: Open the RQA Plots tab and scroll past the continuous panels
Read each partner's gaze recurrence matrix and its Recurrence Rate
Hover a cell for its time pair
Click a cell to move the shared window there
serves_tasks: Check when each partner's attention returns to a previously viewed area

features.name: Cross-wavelet panel with significance contours, phase arrows and band-averaged power
features.general: Compare two signals by their joint power across time and timescale. The panel shows a red-noise 95% significance contour, the cone of influence and phase-relation arrows, and draws the global spectrum and one band's average against their significance lines. An info button explains how to read it.
features.specific: Cross-wavelet analysis tab (vy ↔ vx) has five parts: the normalized input series; a heatmap of Period (s) vs Time with 95% contours and phase arrows; global Power with a dashed 95% line; a 0.1–0.3 s band average with a flat dashed threshold; and a header with Mean Coherence, AR1 and the Monte Carlo chance-level status ('not computed for this output' in every session opened). Clicking the input series moves the shared window; clicking the band-average panel does not. On replay the double-click reset also moved the selected time.
steps: Open the Cross-wavelet analysis tab
Click (i) to read what the figure shows
Hover a phase arrow for time, period, phase and power
Drag a box to zoom into a time–period region, then double-click to reset
Click the input series to move the shared window
serves_tasks: Read joint power and phase across time and period, judged only against a red-noise 95% significance level (no Monte Carlo chance level was available)

features.name: Annotation tier timeline with tier filter and click-to-jump
features.general: Show coded behaviour as coloured interval bars per tier on a shared time axis, with the current window overlaid. Hovering gives the label and duration, checkboxes and all/none buttons pick which tiers show, and clicking an interval moves the time cursor to it.
features.specific: ELAN Annotations tab: tiers such as Gaze Parent/Child, Parent/Child Gesture, Parent/Child SUB-EN and datalogs. A TIERS checklist with all/none sits above. Hovering shows '[Tier] label start–end (duration)', and clicking an annotation jumps there ('Click an annotation to jump to it').
steps: Open the ELAN Annotations tab
Hover an interval to read its label and time span
Uncheck tiers or press none/all to filter
Click an interval to move the shared time window to it
serves_tasks: Read coded behaviour tiers aligned to the timeline with the current window
Show only the tiers of interest

features.name: Path overlay on a background image with active-window highlight
features.general: Draw an object's full 2-D path over a picture of the workspace. The part inside the current time window is highlighted and the current position is marked; if there is no calibrated image, the path is drawn on a blank canvas.
features.specific: Trajectory tab: a thin Full Path line over the spiral board image, a red Active Window segment and a yellow Current Pos dot. The red segment grows with Window Size. Partial sessions (CUF00_L1_A1/A2) show the path without the board image.
steps: Open the Trajectory tab
Move the time slider or click a time point
Change Window Size to lengthen or shorten the highlighted segment
Compare with a session that has no board calibration
serves_tasks: See where the object travelled in space during the window
Confirm which analyses are missing for the incomplete recording

features.name: Stacked signal panels on one shared time axis with a window band
features.general: Plot several signals as stacked panels that share one time axis, with the current analysis window shaded across every panel so their behaviour in the same interval can be compared at a glance.
features.specific: Time series tab: speed, vy and vx panels on a shared Time (s) axis with a teal shaded window across all three. Clicking a panel sets the shared selected time. No gaze traces appear.
steps: Open the Time series tab
Scroll through the speed, vy and vx panels
Read each signal inside the shaded window
Click a panel to move the shared window
serves_tasks: Read the movement signals on a shared time axis with the window marked
